sources.document_title: SHENZHEN SHOUHAN TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD TYPE-C 6P specification (approval sheet)
sources.locator: RATING row 5 V 3 A; PRACTICAL TEMPERATURE RANGE row; ELECTRICAL table rows 3.1-3.3; DURABILITY table row 4.6 LIFE TEST
sources.evidence_extract: Manufacturer-authored approval spec hosted by the distributor. RATING 5 V 3 A; practical temperature -30 to +85 C; contact resistance 40 mohm max at 100 mA or less, 1000 Hz; insulation 100 Mohm min at 100 V DC 1 min; dielectric AC 100 V 1 min, 0.5 mA trip; life test 3000 cycles at 10-25 cycles/min. %PDF-1.7, 1044913 bytes, server Last-Modified 2025-04-11.

sources.document_title: LCSC product page C456012 (SHOU HAN TYPE-C 6P)
sources.locator: Product attribute table rows Number of Contacts 6P, Connector Type Type-C, Voltage Rating 5V, Mounting Type SMD right-angle; productModel row TYPE-C 6P
sources.evidence_extract: Distributor page binds C456012 to brand SHOU HAN, product model TYPE-C 6P, USB 3.1 Type-C female receptacle, 6 contacts, 1 port, SMD right-angle, catalog Voltage Rating row 5V. Canonical identity extract: {"lcsc":"C456012","manufacturer":"SHOU HAN","mpn":"TYPE-C 6P","variant":"USB 3.1 Type-C female receptacle, 6 contacts, SMD right-angle"}. LCSC suggests substitute SH-U262-061N-4BVC11 (C22383472), a different orderable.
sources.refresh_note: Live Nuxt-rendered distributor HTML; the byte hash is not deterministic across retrievals, so the retained canonical identity extract, not the page bytes, is the durable evidence
